context_version_id.description: Optional read-only analytical note context for source-answer-v3. Absence means null; it is not normalized into historical bodies.

extract.description: Obtain missing facts from one currently pinned PDF. Reuse facts first; clarify ambiguity before requesting extraction.

question.description: Self-contained question resolved from task, frozen history and clarifications. Reuse the exact completed_extractions question for the same need.

ExtractionSkip.description: One candidate of an extraction response that ingest left out for a classified reason; the other candidates were checked and saved on their own.

status.description: Processing status of admitted ordinary facts and explicit visual observations, not PDF completeness or verification of model claims. Review candidates remain excluded; alone they leave status empty. Absent in older results.

PdfDiagramRegion.description: Строки внутри одной связной непрозрачной области изображений PDF. Геометрия не заменяет исходные цитаты и проверку числовых фактов.

bounds.description: Границы связанных текстов [left, bottom, right, top] в исходных координатах страницы PDF.

ReviewCandidate.description: Server snapshot of an original numeric candidate rejected locally. References establish provenance, not truth. Only an unaccepted analytical_note paragraph may cite its ID; never a Fact or calculation input.

input.description: Exact original facts item before candidate normalization. All fields are unadmitted model claims, including amount and nature; no computed scale or fact_id. Validated by the unchanged extractor input schema before ingest.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL from the specified search result in this Run. A Unicode hostname is normalized to IDNA by the server.
